# Priscilla Grant

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057)</sub>

## Appearance

Priscilla is described as golden and fair, appearing attractive in silk attire.

_Sources: [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## Personality

Priscilla is thoughtful, imaginative, and reflective, enjoying poetic conversations with her peers about nature and human souls. She possesses creative sensibilities, a desire for fame, and a cheerful disposition.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P58](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0058), [v2 c20 P23](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0023)_

## Traits

- thoughtful  <sub>[v2 c1 P58](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0058)</sub>
- imaginative  <sub>[v2 c1 P58](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0058)</sub>

## Abilities

- teaching  <sub>[v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057)</sub>

## History

Priscilla Grant attended Queen's Academy alongside her close friend Anne Shirley. Following her studies, she accepted a position as the schoolteacher in Carmody. During a visit by her aunt, Mrs. Charlotte E. Morgan, Priscilla brought her aunt and Mrs. Pendexter to visit Anne at Green Gables, where she helped unharness the horse and enjoyed a memorable visit with her companions.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 c20 P23](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0023), [v2 c20 P24](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0024)_
